flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: wait: Waiting without interacting with the covered top-up button

summary:
The agent misread the page layout. The scheduled-maintenance notice is lower on the page and does not cover the “+ Top Up Quota ($250)” control.
Correct the obstruction check to test whether the click point of the requested control is actually covered. Then click the visible quota link with the mouse and verify the expected quota and success status.
one_liner: The quota top-up link was visible and could have been clicked, but the run stopped after incorrectly treating it as covered.
